title: An untracked part shows Not Tracked with its bins, Min and Max in the list
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919); the Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Part Library & Inventory → Create & Edit' and 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' and can see costs and prices.
  • Parts → Inventory is open on the Active tab at {Location-A}.
  • Bin {Bin-A} is the default bin of {Location-A} (for example General Storage), the bin New Inventory Part fills in, and bin {Bin-B} is a second bin at {Location-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BIN-B).
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-NOTTRK-LIST-01) is active and untracked at {Location-A}, with 4 in {Bin-A}, 3 in {Bin-B}, and a saved Min of 2 and Max of 6.
custom_steps:
1. Type the part number of {Part-A} in the Inventory search.
  2. Open the column picker in the toolbar.
  3. Make sure Bin Location / Quantity, Total Qty, Min and Max are switched on, then close the picker.
  4. Read the {Part-A} row in those four columns.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 4: The Total Qty cell reads "Not Tracked" (grey text, no quantity badge).
  • Step 4: The Bin Location / Quantity cell still shows both bins with their quantities: "{Bin-A} | 4" and "{Bin-B} | 3".
  • Step 4: The Min cell reads 2 and the Max cell reads 6, the values saved before tracking was turned off.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10817 (Story 4, Create an Untracked Part); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, as edited 9 Oct 2026 (Ready for dev), S4-R8, S4-R8a, S4-R8b, read 13 Oct 2026; design canvas board 5.3 (The list says Not Tracked) and tracking-note-2, 13 Oct copy. Source-verified 13 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S4-R8: “An untracked part shows "Not Tracked" in the Inventory list's Total Qty column instead of a quantity.”
  • S4-R8a: “On the Inventory list, an untracked part's Bin Location / Quantity column still shows each bin with its quantity.”
  • S4-R8b: “On the Inventory list, an untracked part's Min and Max columns still show the saved values.”
